perspective:
Jose Castillo has access to the following information:

- He works with Patricia Ndiaye at a community bank, where he sometimes helps with maintenance and repairs. They have a friendly, professional relationship.
- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual and recalled she was usually vibrant.
- He asked her if she was okay. She said it was “nothing really,” just personal stuff, and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk. She said she appreciated that and that it meant a lot.
- He later overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He told her he’d been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss them. She said that could be helpful and that she’d been overwhelmed with bills lately.
- He suggested they could look over budgeting tips together, and she thanked him and said she’d take him up on it soon.
- He worried afterward that he might have overstepped, so he told Patricia he didn’t mean to pry and just wanted to help. She said she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend. She said she appreciated that and was glad she had someone to turn to.
- Later he asked about her weekend plans. She said she was fine and planning a quiet weekend at home, and asked about his plans.
- He said he’d probably catch up on reading and relax, and reminded her she could reach out if she needed anything.
- He continued checking in with her at work. She said she was busy but handling it, thanked him, and said it was great to have his support.
- He responded that everyone is there to help each other out.
